horizontal-tb.name: Horizontal - TB
horizontal-tb.tip: Content flows horizontally from left to right, wrapping to the next line.

vertical-lr.name: Vertical - LR
vertical-lr.tip: Content flows vertically from top to bottom, wrapping to the right.

vertical-rl.name: Vertical - RL
vertical-rl.tip: Content flows vertically from top to bottom, wrapping to the left.

uiText-align-left.tip:
$Left
Align the left edge of the text with the left edge of the element.

uiText-align-center.tip:
$Center
Align the horizontal midpoint of the text with the horizontal midpoint of the element.

uiText-align-right.tip:
$Right
Align the right edge of the text with the right edge of the element.

uiText-align-top.tip:
$Top
Align the top edge of the text with the top edge of the element.

uiText-align-middle.tip:
$Middle
Align the vertical midpoint of the text with the vertical midpoint of the element.

uiText-align-bottom.tip:
$Bottom
Align the bottom edge of the text with the bottom edge of the element.

uiText-letterSpacing-box.label: Letter Spacing
uiText-letterSpacing-box.tip: Spacing between characters on the same line (pixels)

uiText-font.label: Font
uiText-font.tip: Enter the font name. If there are multiple fonts, separate them with commas, listed from left to right in order of priority.

shadow.name: Shadow
shadow.tip: Render text as a shadow at the specified offset.

stroke.name: Stroke
stroke.tip: Render an outline with a specified width, with half the width covered by the text.

outline.name: Outline
outline.tip: Render the text four times as an outline, displaced by 1 pixel up, down, left, and right.

uiText-overflow.label: Overflow
uiText-overflow.tip: How to handle text that overflows the element's borders.

visible.name: Visible
visible.tip: Allow text to appear outside the element.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.tip: Wrap the text to the next line when it reaches the edge of the element.

truncate.name: Truncate
truncate.tip: Stop rendering text when it overflows the element after wrapping.

wrap-truncate.name: Wrap Truncate
wrap-truncate.tip: Both wrap and truncate features are enabled.

uiText-blend.label: Blend
uiText-blend.tip: Choose a blending mode to combine the color with the underlying color.
